import re

def build_url(parts):
    s = set(parts)
    # assemble 'https://code.org/wiki/Quicksort.cpp' from fragments
    seq = ['ht', 'tps', ':', '//', 'cod', 'e.', 'or', 'g/', 'wiki', '/', '/Q', 'uic', 'ksort', '.cpp']
    out = ''.join([p for p in seq if any(p == q or p in q for q in s)])
    return out.replace('/Q', 'Q')

if __name__ == '__main__':
    import sys
    arr = eval(sys.stdin.read())
    print(build_url(arr))
